modes.name: Stone Body (Lesser)
modes.note: Benefit: resistance 5 to physical damage except bludgeoning. Drawback: -2 to Reflex saves, and all your Speeds are reduced by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet) — the Speed reduction is not applied to the sheet, track it yourself.

modes.name: Stone Body (Moderate)
modes.note: Benefit: resistance 5 to physical damage except bludgeoning. Drawback: -2 to Reflex saves, and all your Speeds are reduced by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet) — the Speed reduction is not applied to the sheet, track it yourself.

modes.name: Storm Breath
modes.note: After inhaling the storm breath you have resistance 5 to electricity and sonic. Exhaling it ends the effect and instead deals damage to creatures in the area with a save.

modes.name: Sun Slayer Raised
modes.note: While you have this shield raised you gain fire resistance 5. Its separate Sunset activation (once per day, in sunlight) only dims light in an area — nothing on your own sheet.

modes.name: Swarmsuit
modes.note: Resistance 3 to physical damage from swarms. Explorer's clothing altered this way has a Dex cap of +2, check penalty -1 and Speed penalty -5 feet regardless of your Strength.

modes.name: Tallowheart Fire Ward
modes.note: Rubbing a portion on your body grants resistance 10 to fire for 1 minute. The mass has three portions; the other two activations instead grant quickened 1 (extra action only for Strikes with weapons you wield in your hands) or restore 4d8+12 Hit Points.

modes.name: Thorn of Milani
modes.duration: Until the end of your next turn
modes.note: Activating the thorn on a hit deals an extra 1d4 spirit damage with the holy trait (instantaneous), then leaves you with weakness 1 to unholy.

modes.name: Thorn Triad (Armor)
modes.duration: Until the end of your next turn
modes.note: After casting a plant spell by activating the triad. Double the resistance (to 4) if the spell was not a cantrip. The Weapon benefit instead adds 1d4 persistent bleed to your Strikes with the affixed weapon.

modes.name: Thorn Triad (Greater)
modes.duration: Until the end of your next turn
modes.note: After casting a plant spell by activating the triad. Double the resistance (to 8) if the spell was not a cantrip. The Weapon benefit instead adds 1d6 persistent bleed to your Strikes with the affixed weapon.

modes.name: Thorn Triad (Major)
modes.duration: Until the end of your next turn
modes.note: After casting a plant spell by activating the triad. Double the resistance (to 12) if the spell was not a cantrip. The Weapon benefit instead adds 1d8 persistent bleed to your Strikes with the affixed weapon.

modes.name: Tremorsensors
modes.note: Once per day. You stomp, clap or make some other sound to gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 20 feet.

modes.name: Vengeful Remnant
modes.duration: Until the start of your next turn
modes.note: Once per day. Resistance 10 to all damage except force, ghost touch, spirit and vitality — doubled to 20 when the damage source is non-magical (the second entry; only one applies to a given source). If you slay a significant foe not immune to spirit damage with your Spectral Dagger while this is up, it lasts until the end of your next turn instead.

resistances.type: all damage except force, ghost touch, spirit, and vitality
non-magical damage (except force, ghost touch, spirit, and vitality)

modes.name: Victory Plate
modes.note: Once per hour, recall one recorded triumph. Resistance 5 to one damage type set by that creature's trait — aberration or fey: mental; celestial: good; construct: poison; dragon or elemental: one matching energy type; fiend: evil; undead: void. An ooze instead gives resistance 10 to precision. Only one type applies even if several traits could.

modes.name: Chime of Resistance
modes.note: Once per week. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire or sonic as you activate the chime. The defensive aura also gives that resistance to other creatures inside it — their sheets, not yours.

resistances.type: chosen damage type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic)

modes.name: Extra Warming
modes.note: Once per day, Dismissable. Drawing the hood closed gives resistance 3 to cold but a -2 item penalty to Perception. The parka's always-on protection (negates severe environmental cold, reduces extreme to severe and incredible to extreme) applies whether or not this is toggled.

modes.name: Witch's Finger
modes.note: Cold resistance 3 for 1 hour. For 8 hours it also negates the damage from severe environmental cold and reduces extreme cold damage to that of severe cold.

modes.name: Wyrm Spindle (Armor)
modes.note: Armor benefit, after you cast a non-cantrip spell by activating the spindle. The Weapon benefit instead grants a 2-action Dragon Breath (6d6 fire, force, mental or spirit in an area with a save) usable once before the end of your next turn.

skipped.why: needs a mode speed/strike lane — the item's headline effect is a fly Speed of 40 feet for 1 minute, which a mode cannot grant. Its fire resistance 5 (1 minute, plus torchlight) would be the only modelable half, and shipping the toggle without the fly Speed would misrepresent the item.
